name: garlic oil + menthol
uses: shake the container for 2 to 3 times before use, apply it evenly
otcwarn: ■ if following abnormal symptoms occurs after use , stop use and consult with a skin specialist red specks, swelling, itching ■ don’t use on the part where there is injury, eczema, or dermatitis Keep out of reach of children ■ if swallowed, get medical help or contact a person control center immediately
